answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The falcon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the willow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the juniper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
